name: pio-power-relay
description: ESP32 Controlled Power Relay PlatformIO Project
author: lilliputten@gmail.com

scripts.upload-and-monitor: echo --Upload (build if needed) the project, then run serial monitor-- && npm-run-all upload monitor
scripts.build: echo --Build the project-- && pio run -e esp32dev
scripts.upload: echo --Upload (build if needed) the project to connected device-- && pio run -e esp32dev -t upload
scripts.clean: echo --Cleanup the project files-- && pio run -e esp32dev -e native -t clean -v
scripts.monitor: echo --Run serial monitor for the connected device-- && pio device monitor
scripts.format-project-files: echo --Format files in the git project-- && git ls-files | grep -E '\\.[ch]p*$' | xargs clang-format -i --verbose
scripts.format: echo --Format files-- && node find-source-files.js | xargs clang-format -i --verbose
scripts.check: echo --Run source code static analysisn-- && pio check -e esp32dev --src-filters="+<src/>" --src-filters="-<.pio/>"
scripts.uploadfs: echo --Re-upload LittleFS files from data folder-- && pio run --target buildfs && pio run --target uploadfs
scripts.ide-config-vim: echo --Initialize vim environment-- && pio init --ide vim
scripts.ide-config-vscode-default: echo --Initialize vscode default environment-- && pio init --ide vscode --environment esp32dev
scripts.ide-config-vscode-native: echo --Initialize vscode test environment-- && pio init --ide vscode --environment native
